authority_policy: m05cc_v2.record_schema.json is the sole executable TSV/header/type/key/join authority; this v1 document is retained only to explain historical intent and must never authorize preflight, materialization, or transport output.
event_key_contract: (geometry,mode,family,job_id,seed,shard_index,simulation_event_id); stable_root_id is the cross-table root join within a job

activation.source: activation joined one-to-one by simulation_event_id+stable_root_id+eventlist_id to roots and by job identity to the native isotope DAT; production_serial is the exact native AddIsotope commit serial

deposit_truth.source: Historical only. Production deposits.tsv is header-only diagnostic (row_count=0); TES pixels and geometry-specific active blocks are streaming aggregates. Byte-exact native full-event IA/HT truth is retained only for raw-TES-positive roots and outcome-independent preregistered controls. Active-veto-only roots retain typed block aggregates without full truth.

derivations.active_occupancy: mass_csi_keV>0 or o8_bgo_keV>0 or o8_plastic_keV>0; Kapton is excluded

event.source: events joined to planned_job_manifest by job and to roots by simulation_event_id+stable_root_id

ht_truth.source: byte-exact native MSimEvent fragment selected by truth_index offset/length/hash; parse every HT/GR/DR record fail-closed

ia_truth.source: byte-exact native MSimEvent fragment selected by truth_index offset/length/hash; parse every IA record including INIT/PAIR/ANNI/DECA fail-closed

job_footer.source: footer joined to planned job, native isotope DAT and post-run receipt; DAT path/hash cannot be inferred from a filename

pixel.source: pixels streaming aggregates: energy, PRE energy-weighted centroid, POST time min/max/energy-weighted, deposit_count and first/last sequence; production does not require per-step deposits

derivations.sampling_contract: analog p=q over the complete corrected source support

root.source: roots joined one-to-one by row_index0/eventlist_id/stable_root_id to the frozen tape root sidecar

run.source: write-once benchmark contract, planned-job manifest, tape manifest, geometry bundle, shadow-build manifest, active-volume whitelist, post-run receipt and per-table hashes; missing post-run fields are PENDING before transport and must never be defaulted

truth_index.source: truth_index joined by simulation_event_id+stable_root_id to candidate/control roots; offset+length+sha256 addresses one byte-exact native MSimEvent fragment

selection_contract: Every raw-TES-positive root and every deterministic outcome-independent pre-registered control has a native full-truth fragment. Active-veto-only roots retain typed geometry-specific block aggregates but no full truth; Kapton alone never selects truth.
unsupported_policy: A consumer that cannot obtain a required field through these exact tables, joins or derivations must fail with UNSUPPORTED; it must not synthesize a default.
